01 — On the work

Canvas, paper,
and sometimes a human face.
The imagination stays the same.

Sandra works in several techniques side by side: acrylic, watercolour, neurographics and artistic make-up. The same subjects keep returning: faces, forests, the sea, horses and characters from fairy tales.

05 — Workshops

Workshops
with Sandra.

Sandra teaches children and adults and runs neurographics and painting workshops. This is what it looks like from the inside.

01

Neurographics

You draw lines without planning, round off the corners and colour them in. It is far more calming than it sounds.

02

Colour and material

Acrylic, watercolour, pastel and markers. No experience needed.

03

Children and adults

Lessons and workshops for children, adults and groups.

06 — Nice to meet you

Sandra
Leifer.

Artist and art teacher. She paints, teaches and does artistic make-up.

Sandra studied art in Yaroslavl, Russia. Her works are full of fantasy: an alchemist holding a bottle of light, a horse made of lightning, a tree that is all a mosaic of colour. Alongside painting she teaches children and adults, runs workshops, and writes fairy tales for children that she also illustrates.

Painting
Acrylic, watercolour and pastel
Line
Neurographics and drawing
Body
Theatre make-up and body art
Words

07 — Fairy tales

Fairy tales
for children.

Two stories, in Hebrew and in Russian. Read them on the screen or aloud at bedtime.

Illustrated book · 29 pages

The Tale of the Unicorn

In a hidden valley among high mountains, a girl sets out on a journey of courage, compassion and a wonderful friendship.

Open the book
New
A new tale · 8 chapters

The Tale of the Dragon

The last dragon in the valley, an angry North Wind, and Nadia the healer, who sets out alone to save everyone.
